reason: Storage sender admission and lifecycle hardening (#1092), finishing #1033 on top of the #1112 sender ingress. Reports run on their own report lane so a source's backlog never delays operator work or control commands; per-source and per-project caps of unexecuted reports answer 429 with Retry-After before anything is saved; disabling, revoking, rotating or moving a source cancels its queued reports; finished reports are pruned with their payloads; promotion, handoff, target and recovery fences count only unfinished reports and run inside the save transaction under the project's ownership lock; an interrupted report is requeued a bounded number of times instead of becoming uncertain; a pending storage dispatch is worker demand and holds idle retirement; project deletion removes the project's source-owned storage rows; project-less storage rows route to their source's project. test_storage_report_backlog, test_storage_alert_dispatch, test_storage_report_compatibility, test_api_worker, test_storage_integrations, test_storage_sender and test_runtime_principal hold the regressions; test_runtime_coordination, test_runtime_delivery, test_runtime_routing, test_deployment_lifecycle, test_project_handoff_agent, test_project_handoff_admission, test_execution_worker, test_runtime_context_requirements, test_shutdown_admission, test_admission_retry, test_idle_retirement_dispatch, test_runtime_quiescence, test_runtime_work_batches and test_api_worker_composition cover the lane, claim, delivery, routing, fence, handoff, admission and shutdown paths changed. test_runtime_coordination and test_api_worker_composition also make CI provision PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI or native code changed. test_project_view_leases.py is excluded: test_lease_tables_are_additive_and_downgrade_to_the_previous_schema fails identically on origin/main (its downgrade target predates 0050). test_runtime_worker_features.py, test_mixed_release_idle_retirement.py and test_shutdown_readmission.py spawn real Cores or workers and are excluded; a scratch supervisor Core on PostgreSQL ran the sender, burst, revoke, Retry and shutdown journey instead. Playwright storage-integrations is excluded (real-core.spec.ts is not run on main). All unrelated tests excluded.
